message.content: {"basis": "The dashboard displays a bar chart with explicit percentage annotations above each bar: Edge (87%), Firefox (23%), Chrome (5%), Safari (1%), and Others (3%). The O/B check for record r2 confirms these percentage inscriptions are the authoritative market_share values and that Edge has the highest value (87%). The policy table explicitly states to select the browser with the highest current market_share. Therefore, Edge is the browser to be assigned to the priority compatibility-testing queue.", "option_label": "Assign Edge to the priority compatibility-testing queue"}
